title: Hiring and onboarding: the current-state blueprint
subtitle: Nine journey stages from a candidate wondering where to find a job to their first shift, across the candidate, the people behind the counter and the systems. The failure points are the moments that matter that failed basic expectations.

lanes.name: Candidate (frontstage)
cells: Where do I even find jobs? || Careers site, word of mouth, walk-ins; no clear path from customer to crew.
Browses roles; hours unclear || Job posts stay live and duplicates confuse.
Asks family; weighs a first job || Nothing answers what it is really like; no employer brand separate from the consumer brand.
Long form; repeats information per store || The form asks more than it decides.
Dining-room table; rushed || No quiet space, no rapport.
Offer lands in spam || Slow confirmation; candidates vanish.
Documents repeated; consent expiry || The same documents asked for repeatedly; consent forms expire.
Online training; no device || Training quality varies with trainer availability.
Uniforms missing; hallway training || The first shift begins not ready.

lanes.name: Backstage and people
cells: Managers hire constantly; no campaigns || Hiring is constant and uncoordinated.
Job posts left live; duplicates || Stale listings across stores and franchisee groups.
No employer brand || The consumer brand stands in for it.
Managers re-key into systems || Candidate data re-entered across systems.
Manager capability varies || Interviews are rushed.
Slow confirmation || Offers wait on manual paperwork.
Payroll finds errors at pay time || Wrong documents surface only at pay time.
Trainer availability varies || Hard to learn when shifts are spread out.
Manager absorbs the admin || Recruitment sits inside a full day-to-day role.

lanes.name: Systems and automation
cells: Careers site; no employee channel || No dedicated channel from customer to crew.
Careers site and recruiting platform || Two surfaces, duplicate listings, no single source of truth.
No content layer || Nothing to answer the candidate's real question.
Recruiting platform || Multi-system form today; conversational screening in the target state.
Manual scheduling || Target state: auto-scheduled interviews with instant confirmation.
Manual offers || Target state: offers generated and tracked automatically.
Work-rights check; payroll || Target state: automated checks with a human review lane; guided capture for first-job candidates.
Learning platform; employee records || Target state: record auto-created with twice-daily pushes to scheduling and payroll.
Time and attendance || First-shift attendance not measured anywhere.

lanes.name: Failure points
cells: F-01 No path from customer to crew
F-02 Duplicate and stale listings
F-03 No employer story
F-04 The form asks more than it decides
F-05 Rushed interviews in the dining room
F-06 Offers lost and slow
F-07 Documents repeated; consent expires
F-08 Training varies with the trainer
F-09 First shift not ready; no attendance data
